items.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Swetman told me that Freddie played with him for a while... [INTERVIEWEE] I tell you, in 99, I didn't know, I was wearing short pants.

ctx.x: But Joe was most of us more of a style. And Louis still is a blue chord man. And he was a blues artist chord. And a hot chord man. But Freddie was great on breaks. He was great on... I had some kind of a new sort of... He could blue also and some of the other things he could do. Now, another thing Freddie kept with you. I don't know whether it's on the record or not. They sent for Tim Brown. Sent for the farm at the... Oh... Coconut Grove in New York. Had a big band. And the rich, the millionaires came to his…
Swetman told me that Freddie played with him for a while at a beach ballroom. And about 1919. Do you think that might have been the same time? Same period?
Yeah, that was... 1919 was there after the war. Yeah. About the same time.
